topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning outcomes and setting the context for studying cancer genetics and cell transformation.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional classification of cancer-driving mutations and illustrate the mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair pathways and mitotic machinery generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the stepwise model of mutation accumulation in tumorigenesis and how inherited mutations accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary, recommended reading, and a preview of the upcoming session.
